title: Exceptional maps and abelian points in backward orbits
summary: Consider a number field $K$, a polarized endomorphism $f:X\to X$ on a normal projective variety, and a non-exceptional point $α$ for $f$. We show that the extension $K(f^{-\infty}(α))/K$ generated by the backward orbit of $α$ is virtually abelian if and only if $f$ is an exceptional map with CM and $α$ is $f$-preperiodic. This answers a conjecture of Andrews and Petsche and extends it to higher dimensions.
